summary: At process switch `pre_handoff_regression` value `touched_suites`, QA's final `delivery_verification.py run --kind test` reuses the accepted pre-handoff regression run for the earlier stories' targets on the frozen tree instead of running them a second time. The runner derives the frozen candidate's selection again and reuses the run only when it passed intact on the frozen tree, with that selection and the approved command derived for it, in the declared environment of QA's run, the variables run evidence binds, and no longer ago than final evidence stays fresh; `run --fresh` reuses nothing and runs every suite. It writes the earlier stories' targets, apart from the Item's own Test Plan targets and every earlier target that prefixes one or lies under one, which QA always runs, so a command that skips by node id prefix as pytest's `--deselect` does still runs them, to `reused-tests.json` and names it in the new runner variable `AGENTROF_REUSED_TESTS`, which no other command receives, an inherited one included, since `lane-run` now unsets it and `AGENTROF_DIAGNOSTIC_TESTS` as well, and which the run checks after its command, as a diagnostic selection, so a command that changed the list does not pass; an approved test command that skips those ids runs only the Item's own story and every suite the run did not cover. The run's identity records `reused_pre_handoff`, the reused run's evidence hash and the reused test ids by earlier story, and a run that reused nothing names the binding that differed as `pre_handoff_reuse`. Evidence approval checks the reuse as recorded: the frozen session's accepted run, passed intact on the frozen tree, still fresh at approval as QA's own record must be, of the approved command and in the same declared environment, with only test ids that run selected and none that is, prefixes or lies under one of the Item's own. Each pre-handoff run now records its declared environment, and the frozen session keeps the accepted run's command, workdir and environment. `approve-item-evidence` records the reuse in the Item's verification record, below the pre-handoff runs: each reused earlier story with its test ids, the reused run and its evidence hash, or that QA's final test run reused nothing. The switch reference asks QA to spot-run one reused group per Delivery through the diagnostic adapter and to name the reused stories in its report, and its measurement adds the wall clock of QA's final test run and the stories it reused. In one measured Delivery each reader round repeated about 83 minutes of earlier-story suites that the implementation had just run on the same tree. At `off`, the default, nothing changes.
